faqs.question: Do you provide editable templates?
faqs.answer: Yes — we can deliver reusable templates (Canva or design files) so your team produces on-brand posts without starting from scratch.

faqs.question: Can you match our existing brand?
faqs.answer: Yes — we design to your brand guidelines, or help define them if you do not have any yet.

faqs.question: Do you deliver in Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes — bilingual Arabic + English with full RTL support, so both audiences get a first-class experience.

faqs.question: Do we own the result?
faqs.answer: Completely. You keep the accounts, data, and configurations. There is no lock-in to CloudTopia.
